messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Page fired -> PD:INC-84217 (latency p95/p99 spike; service=inference-router)
Maya: acked. I'm on it, pinging infra.
Owen: +1, grabbing traces and warmup metrics. Any immediate customer-impact notes?
Elsa: CS reports two customers on dedicated saw timeouts ~12s for completions starting ~17:22 UTC, embedded calls unaffected. Ticket opened.
Maya: good, thanks @Elsa. Initial graph shows p95 jumped from 220ms -> 3.2s, p99 ~ 10s. Looks correlated with a burst of batched requests to model-variant v3-quantized in us-west-2.
Owen: pulling sidecar logs now. running: `curl -s http://observability/api/query?series=latency&svc=inference-router&since=60m`
Ana: curious if autoscaler/backoff kicked. I see large KV cache evictions around 17:20 UTC. Could be eviction storm -> cold kv loads increasing tokenization time.
Kai: infra checks: no infra node restarts, but GPU utilization on dedicated-pool-7 is pegged at 97% across few hosts, queue depth rising. Might be a tight hotkey fanout.
Maya: ok plan: 1) stabilize: set routing fallback to cheaper variant (v3-small) for 10m 2) trigger kv-cache prewarm on hot shards 3) throttle large-batch producers 4) notify PD rotation if we need manual capacity.
Owen: executing fallback route change now: `redwoodctl route update --service inference-router --policy fallback=v3-small --duration 10m`
Incident Bot: route update requested by Owen. Change queued.
Owen: done — rollout submitted, hitting canary at 10% then 100% (logs: rollout id r-78f2).
Maya: I also pushed a temporary rate-limit on requests with tokens>4096: `config:set router.max_tokens=4096 --scope=global` — should reduce oversized batches.
Ana: KV prewarm command: `infra-tool prewarm-kv --shard hotkey-17 --ttl 600` — ran it, watching warmth metrics.
Kai: added one extra GPU to dedicated-pool-7 as manual burst: `cloudctl autoscale set dedicated-pool-7 --instances +1` — won't be instant but helps queue.
Elsa: CS updated customers: “we're seeing degraded completions, working on mitigation; ETA ~10-15m”
Owen: p95 down to ~420ms after rollout started, p99 trending to 1.8s. So far improvement looks aligned with fallback.
Maya: good. keep watching. If p99 stays >2s after 10m we escalate PD rotation and increase burst further.
Incident Bot: PagerDuty alert escalated (PD:INC-84217) -> to rotation-2 at 17:31 UTC (escalation due to ongoing p99 > 2s)
Owen: attaching relevant logs snippet: ```
[17:19:58] router: evicting kv shard hotkey-17 (size=12.3MB)
[17:20:02] tokenizer: cold-start tokenization time=524ms (path=model-tok-v2)
[17:20:08] runtime: batch exec queued=128 exec_ms=9800
```
Maya: note for postmortem: check prefix-caching TTLs and autoscaler hysteresis for dedicated pools. Add a test harness that replays hotkey fanout patterns.
Ana: agreed. I'll start a tag in the incident board and add runbook steps we followed.
Maya: final checkin: p95 ~ 260ms, p99 ~ 890ms and trending down. I'm going to close the immediate mitigation but keep watch for 30m. If everyone is happy, I will mark PD incident as acknowledged/stable.
Elsa: customers notified with follow-up. No new escalations.
Owen: confirming logs show fewer evictions and batch queue lengths normalized.
Kai: autoscaler commit rolled back to normal (+1 instance removed) once metrics stable.
Maya: closing loop — will start a blameless postmortem draft after cool-off window. Great work team :tada:
